findings.finding: The committed contract records the boundary between the two branches of § 99-15-59 in an imperative: 'Never apply the twelve-month no-charge clock here.'
findings.consequence: The packet states it on the filing instructions page and in its stop conditions. The no-charge branch is a separate family already built on this branch of the factory, and neither packet is the other's instrument.

findings.finding: The compiled Mississippi line naming § 99-15-59 covers both branches expressly — 'not formally charged or prosecuted within 12 months of arrest, OR whose charge was dismissed' — so it answers this route's destination question.
findings.consequence: The destination is stated from it rather than delegated. A line keyed only to the other branch would not have been used: DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A3.
